outcome.answer: The BL19 digital collection retrieval benchmark is described in “Cultural Analytics for Good: Building Inclusive Evaluation Frameworks for Historical IR” [1]. It uses the British Library’s BL19 collection of more than 35,000 works from 1700–1899, with expert-designed queries and paragraph-level relevance annotations to evaluate historical retrieval [1]. The work also investigates whether knowledge from fiction can improve retrieval for scholarly and factual materials [1].
